Classic rock ballad, dramatic and heavy, distorted electric guitars, driving double-kick drums, soaring operatic male vocals, powerful choir backing, epic atmosphere, slow build to explosive chorus
Choose the complete song's natural length and structure yourself. There is no required target duration. The safety ceiling is 900 seconds, not a goal to fill. Compose a coherent intro, verses, chorus and resolved final outro with final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words and then end the song naturally. No endless loop or unfinished solo. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
A cold wind cuts through the frozen air
The clock strikes twelve, no one is there
A shadow stretches on the broken street
A promise made in blood and heat
I looked inside my hollow eyes
And saw the truth I couldn't hide

[Chorus]
Rise up, my four shadows
Riding through the dark
Breaking down the walls
That hold my heart
Four shadows coming
To claim their throne
The battle is joined
In flesh and bone

[Verse]
The first one laughs with a silver tongue
A debt to pay, a debt to hang
The second weeps with a heavy hand
A flood of tears in the promised land
The third one waits with a quiet breath
A door to heaven, a door to death

[Chorus]
Rise up, my four shadows
Riding through the dark
Breaking down the walls
That hold my heart
Four shadows coming
To claim their throne
The battle is joined
In flesh and bone

[Bridge]
And the fourth one stands with a crown of thorns
A king of nothing, a king of storms
He looks at me with a gentle stare
And whispers, "Son, you're almost there"
I fall to my knees in the dust and sand
Holding the weight of my own hand

[Chorus]
Rise up, my four shadows
Riding through the dark
Breaking down the walls
That hold my heart
Four shadows coming
To claim their throne
The battle is joined
In flesh and bone

[Outro]
Four shadows... fading
In the morning light
The battle is over
We are gone tonight
Gone tonight
